environment.description: Ubuntu-based GitHub Codespace / local dev container with 2 vCPU and 4 GB RAM, running the Node 20 backend and MongoDB service for the app at http://localhost:3000.
environment.notes: This result reflects the provided environment rather than a production-grade benchmark. The host was resource constrained and the frontend/backend were running in the same low-memory container.

summary: Limited by environment. The measured p95 response times exceed the 3-second target for login and dashboard requests, while the error rate stays below the 1% threshold. The environment is therefore recorded as resource-limited rather than a fully representative production run.
